about.manifesto:
A demo project with an opinion.
Lingerie is a garment, not a promise.
No “you'll feel”. No “sensual”. No “emotional collection”.
Sheer is called sheer. Black is called black.
Whoever wears it decides.
about.how.title: How we work
about.how.construction.title: Construction
about.how.construction.body: Every piece starts from a measurement. Seams, fastenings and metal stay visible.
about.how.materials.title: Materials
about.how.materials.body: Mesh, tulle, matt microfibre, silk jersey. Composition for every part of the garment. Sheer is called sheer.
about.how.bodies.title: Bodies
about.how.bodies.body: Sizes 65–95 A–G and XS–3XL. Not one word on how a body should look.

terms.what.title: What this site is
terms.what.body: LINGERAI is a showcase site. It shows how an online shop would work: catalogue, sizes, bag, checkout.

terms.sale.body: Nothing on this site is an offer to the public. Completing the demo checkout doesn't create a contract. No order is fulfilled, no payment is requested or taken.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.real.a: No. It's a demo: nothing is for sale, no order ships.
faq.charge.a: No. The checkout doesn't ask for a card and takes no payment.
faq.size.q: How do I find my size?
faq.size.a: The underwired bra in EU band and cup, everything else in letter sizes XS–3XL. → Size guide
faq.sheer.q: How do I know if a piece is sheer?
faq.sheer.a: It's on every product page, under the price: sheer, semi-sheer or opaque.
faq.care.a: Instructions on each product page, under Care. In short: hand wash cold, never tumble dry.
faq.hygiene.a: In the demo, yes, with the hygiene liner intact. → Returns
care.standard: Hand wash cold, or machine wash at 30°C in a mesh laundry bag. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron. Dry flat.
care.underwire: Hand washing recommended: it protects the underwire.
care.silk: Hand wash cold with a silk detergent only, or dry clean. Do not wring. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Iron inside out on a low heat. Dry flat, away from direct sun.
care.hardware: Hand wash cold only. Dry metal parts straight away. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron.
